'''Beloved Of Bast''' is a [[special]] card.  It first appeared in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
When you gain this card, take the [[Nine Lives]] card as well.

'''Upkeep''': Gain 1 [[Sanity]] or 1 [[Stamina]].

Discard this card if the [[Ancient One]] awakens.
